value.rationale: For every prime-field affine group with a nontrivial cyclic multiplier order >=3, a canonical connected three-step convolution has exactly two recoverability regimes, with a universal nullity jump p-1 controlled by ord_p(-2). This identifies a natural arithmetic obstruction and simultaneous disappearance of one Fourier mode per nontrivial induced block. It is a complete infinite-family rank classification, not a table of small cases or mere restatement of standard representation theory.
